steps: Existing member completes the New Member Referral Form and gives it to family/friends. Friend brings the form and two forms of ID to a branch to become a member and opens a Checking Account.
catches: Member completes the New Member Referral Form and gives it to friends/family (no limit on copies). Friend brings the completed form and two forms of ID to a branch to become a member. The $25 deposit is earned for each person who opens a new membership with a Checking Account after both accounts have been open and in good standing for at least 60 days. (The 'up to $75' amount on the page is the NEW MEMBER's bonus for direct deposit/loan/card/term-share, not the referrer's.)
